item.title: about & CV
item.description:
WHOAMI

  • I spent four rewarding years at Fuzhou University, majoring in Artificial Intelligence.
  • I interned at the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences, under Prof. Xiang Ling (https://ryderling.github.io/).
  • I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Computer Engineering at Aarhus University.
  • I worked with Prof. Anders Møller (https://cs.au.dk/~amoeller/) on taint analysis.
  • I am currently an exchange student at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
  • I will conduct my master’s thesis at CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security in collaboration with Ruijie Meng.
  • I am deeply interested in the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity and plan to pursue a Ph.D. in this area.

Internship experiences

  1. Yigeyun (Jan 2023 - Mar 2023)
  2. ISCAS (Jul 2023 - Mar 2025)

Research experiences:

Google Scholar

Some awards

AI competition

  • CVPR 2025 Workshop – Jailbreaking Attacks on Multimodal Foundation Models — 1st place, Team Leader (May 2025)
    • Jailbroke two provided multimodal models plus one black-box model; achieved the top score of 93.56.
  • AIGC Adversarial Detection Competition, Image Attack Track (Tencent Zhuque Lab) — 1st place, Team Leader (May 2025)
    • Built an automated prompt generator to make V2I outputs evade the Zhuque AIGC detector; writeup.
  • Datacon 2024 AI Security Track — Top 3 / First Prize (Team Leader, Dec 2024)
    • Led LLM hallucination triggering and LLM-based threat intelligence extraction; delivered a graph-based RAG threat-intel extractor.
    • Competition link | Recap.
  • ByteDance / ByteAI AI Security Competition — 3rd place, Team Leader (Nov 2024)
    • Built an automated jailbreak tool bypassing LLM defenses; focused on prompt leaking & jailbreak challenges.
    • Competition link | Recap.
